title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
hint_1: A 1984 prequel so unrelentingly dark — child slavery, ritual murder, a man having his heart pulled out while still alive — that it personally forced the MPAA to invent the PG-13 rating.
hint_2: A nightclub singer in a sequined gown, a Shanghai shootout, a cargo plane crash, a raft used as a parachute, and we haven't even reached the part with the bugs.
hint_3: You've seen this. The mine cart chase. The rope bridge. A kid sidekick named Short Round yelling at his mentor to hold on.
hint_4: Kali Ma. A whip, a fedora, and a leading man who would later spend several decades being grumpy about playing this character.

title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
hint_1: A 2008 legacy sequel that arrived nineteen years after the previous chapter and immediately introduced a word the internet would not let anyone forget — "nuked."
hint_2: Our hero survives a nuclear blast inside a lead-lined refrigerator, which is the moment a generation of fans collectively decided their childhood was over.
hint_3: Either you haven't seen this, or you have and that's somehow worse. A Soviet villain with a bob haircut, a jungle chase, a long-lost son in a leather jacket, and aliens. Yes, aliens.
hint_4: Shia LaBeouf swinging through the trees with CGI monkeys. The whip. The hat. The franchise that should have stopped one movie earlier.

title: Indiana Jones and the Dial of Destiny
hint_1: A 2023 sendoff for an eighty-year-old action hero, which is roughly the cinematic equivalent of asking your grandfather to run a marathon for closure.
hint_2: It opens with a digitally de-aged opening sequence on a Nazi train, because nothing says "this franchise still has it" like spending forty million dollars to make a man look forty years younger.
hint_3: At this point I have to ask — have you been paying attention to the prompts? A fedora, a whip, an archaeologist, a goddaughter, and an Archimedes invention that lets you time travel.
hint_4: The fifth and final outing for our whip-cracking professor. His first name is the answer. His last name is also the answer. Pick one.
